
[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- main.volt:3[/yellow bold]

GPIO 4 is on ADC2, which is BLOCKED while WiFi is active. Analog reads will return errors or garbage.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware {
 [dim]3 |[/dim]     pin sensor: Analog = 4
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Use ADC1 pins instead (GPIO 32-39) which work with WiFi.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNHANDLED FAILURE -- main.volt:6[/yellow bold]

`wifi.connect` can fail, and nothing here says what happens then: the program carries on without a connection.

 [dim]5 |[/dim] setup {
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("net", "pass")
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Add a fallback: `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]
